/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/fatima-zehra-ka-bhra-ghar-lta.md\")
original = path.read_bytes()
refrain = \"Kat gaya Shabbir ka sukha gala\"
opening = [\"Haaye ghazab ho gaya\", \"Fatima Zahra ka bhara ghar luta\", refrain]
stanzas = [
    [\"Ya Husain Ya Husain Ya Husain\", \"Chaand Muharram ka nazar aa gaya\", \"Bas gayi Karb o Bala\", *opening],
    [\"Maah-e-Muharram mein yeh kya ho gaya\", refrain],
    [\"Momino viraan Madina hua\", \"Ho gayi aabaad magar Karbala\", \"Rote haiṅ marqad mein Rasul-e-Khuda\"],
    [refrain],
    [\"Haaye woh Aashur ko Karb o Bala\", \"Bhul na paaenge yeh ahl-e-aza\", \"Aakhir yeh Muhammad pe thi kaisi jafa\"],
    [refrain],
    opening,
    [\"Ho gayi pardes mein barbaadiyaaṅ\", \"Bain yeh karti raheiṅ shehzaadiyaaṅ\", \"Shaam talak jaaenge ham berida\"],
    [refrain],
    opening,
    [\"Khun ka tasht barasta raha\", \"Khun yeh Haidar ka Muhammad ka tha\", \"Had yeh hai khun Ali Asghar baha\", refrain],
    [\"Shaam-e-Gharibaaṅ hui khaime jale\", \"Ahl-e-haram khaak pe baithe rahe\", \"Sayyid-e-Sajjaad ka nauha yeh tha\", refrain],
    opening,
    [\"Nauha Ali Ji o Shanawar parho\", \"Sarwar o Rehan ke baazu bano\", \"Karb mein dubi hui aaye sada\", *opening],
]
header, old_roman = original.split(b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)
_, body = old_roman.split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)
source_blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in body.decode().strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")]
western_digits = str.maketrans(\"۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹\", \"0123456789\")
assert [block[0].translate(western_digits) for block in source_blocks] == [str(i) for i in range(1, len(stanzas) + 1)]
assert [len(block) - 1 for block in source_blocks] == list(map(len, stanzas))
roman = \"\\n\\n\".join(\"\\n\".join(f\"  {line}\" for line in [str(number), *verses]) for number, verses in enumerate(stanzas, 1))
assert all(char.isascii() or char == \"ṅ\" for char in roman)
path.write_bytes(header + b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + roman.encode() + b\"\\n---\\n\" + body)
saved = path.read_bytes()
assert saved.split(b\"\\n---\\n\", 1)[1] == body
assert saved.split(b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)[0] == header
print(f\"Verified {sum(map(len, stanzas))} verses across {len(stanzas)} stanzas. Urdu body and other metadata are byte-identical.\")
PY"
